results.title: John Ratzenberger
results.text: John Dezso Ratzenberger (born April 6, 1947) is an American actor, voice actor, and entrepreneur. He is best known as Cliff Clavin in "Cheers". He is also known for his extensive vocal work in Pixar Animation Studios' films, notably Hamm in the "Toy Story" franchise and Mack in the "Cars" franchise.

results.title: Toy Story (franchise)
results.text: Toy Story is a computer animated film series and Disney media franchise that began with the original 1995 film, "Toy Story", produced by Pixar Animation Studios and released by Walt Disney Pictures. The franchise is based on the anthropomorphic concept that all toys, unknown to humans, are secretly alive, and the films focus on a diverse group of toys that feature a classic cowboy, Sheriff Woody, and modern spaceman, Buzz Lightyear. The group unexpectedly embark on adventures that challenge and change them.
